newsitem.title: USA: NY precious metals called to open mixed.
newsitem.headline: NY precious metals called to open mixed.

text.p: COMEX and NYMEX precious were expected to open mixed Friday, with gold and silver little changed but platinum group metals (PGMs) higher.
COMEX August gold was called unchanged to up $0.50 from Thursday's close of $320.80 an ounce after trading between $320.40 and $322.10 on ACCESS.

Further shortcovering in Hong Kong and Europe overnight provided gold with some support, but investors are still seen cautious with gold in yen terms only at a two-year low and in Indian rupees only at a four-year low compared to the 12-year low priced in dollars.
